name: scrapingbee
description: Fetch and read any web page, search the web, crawl a site, or pull structured data out of pages — whenever a task needs content from a website. Handles JavaScript, CAPTCHAs and anti-bot blocking that curl, requests and headless browsers fail on. Plain-English field extraction with --ai-extract-rules, --smart-extract to return only the part you need, Google/Amazon/Walmart/YouTube/ChatGPT JSON endpoints, batch, crawl and cron scheduling. Bundles the ScrapingBee MCP server (18 tools) and skills for the ScrapingBee CLI.
suggestedPrompts: Get me the full text of this JavaScript-heavy pricing page as clean markdown
I have a CSV of 200 product URLs: fetch the current price for each and update the CSV in place
Crawl this docs site and save every /guide/ page as markdown for my RAG index
